messages:
Ravi Menon: FYI - Skyline Data (acct SD-331) missed INV-2026-102 for $26,400. They emailed saying a partner outage caused unexpected replayed jobs. Asking to split and request a $3,000 goodwill adjustment. Tagging CS + Billing.
Claire Brooks: I pulled the account. Net30, currently 28 days overdue. No prior formal plans. Ticket #TKT-5192 created by CS.
Olivia - CS: Customer called; they're asking for a 3-month plan (0/50/50) and the $3k credit. Offered to wire initial payment if we approve. They also want the invoice line to omit raw job IDs.
Marta Ruiz: Policy: initial payment must be >=25% for multi-month plans. Credits up to $2,000 can be approved by operations; above that needs manager/legal. Also we avoid 0/50/50.
Ken (Billing): Proposed compromise: 30% now, 35% in 30 days, 35% in 60 days. Approve up to $2,000 credit pending eng validation. If eng confirms duplicate replay, escalate for the additional $1,000. Will hold suspension 72h while we sort.
collect ions-bot: Dunning notice #2 sent at 1969002100. Auto-suspend paused for 72h.
Ravi Menon: Engineering - can you verify whether the partner replay led to duplicate ingest? If yes, we can consider crediting additional $1k.
Olivia - CS: Sent their payloads to eng (ENG-3198). Customer agreed to 30/35/35 and said they'll initiate wire for 30% within 48h if we include the goodwill credit.
Marta Ruiz: Approving $2,000 credit now. Add clause: "credit contingent on signed payment agreement and one-time only." If eng confirms additional fault, loop Legal for the remaining $1k.
Ken (Billing): Drafting INV-2026-102-A with $2,000 credit. New balance $24,400. Schedule: 30% ($7,320) due 2025-12-03, 35% ($8,540) due 2026-01-02, 35% ($8,540) due 2026-02-01. DocuSign will be sent.
collections-bot: DocuSign sent -> viewed at 1969003000. Reminder set: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-04.
Claire Brooks: Added account note: "Conditional payment plan approved; initial 30% required to avoid suspension until 2026-01-10."
Ravi Menon: If initial payment fails, immediate resume suspension and escalate. If eng later confirms more error, we'll evaluate extra credit with Legal.
Olivia - CS: Customer viewed DocuSign and requested redaction of internal job ids on invoice lines. Billing confirmed will sanitize.
Ken (Billing): I scheduled a check for 2025-12-04 to confirm funds. I'll post receipts when they come in.
collections-bot: Reminder scheduled: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-04.
Marta Ruiz: Thanks team. Proceed with $2k credit and staged payments; route any extra credit request to Legal.
